notes.title: Heart Rate Monitor Clarification!! Please Read
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We had previously mentioned that our game supports Bluetooth connectivity. We just want to clarify that this is NOT the case. We tried really, really hard to make that happen, but we just didn't have the time, money or resources to make this happen. 

We are happy to announce that after some additional testing, including on a Wahoo TICKR, we can confirm that ANY Heart Rate Monitoring device that uses an ANT+ connection will be able to be used with our game. 

We also previously mentioned that the Polar H10 was a compatible device. As the Polar H10 does NOT support ANT+ we cannot use this device in our game. ONLY devices that support ANT+ will work. 

--In other news--

We're still working on the game, fixing bugs, patching and testing. We'll be sending out a new build in the next week or so and we'll include some patch notes on the game. 

Thanks for checking us out, and please tell your friends about us!!

Red Meat Games Team
